papers.title: Corvid: Improving Multimodal Large Language Models Towards Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in multimodal perception and understanding. However, leading open-source MLLMs exhibit significant limitations in complex and structured reasoning, particularly in tasks requiring deep reasoning for decision-making and problem-solving. In this work, we present Corvid, an MLLM with enhanced chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning capabilities. Architecturally, Corvid incorporates a hybrid vision encoder for informative visual representation and a meticulously designed connector (GateMixer) to facilitate cross-modal alignment. To enhance Corvid's CoT reasoning capabilities, we introduce MCoT-Instruct-287K, a high-quality multimodal CoT instruction-following dataset, refined and standardized from diverse public reasoning sources. Leveraging this dataset, we fine-tune Corvid with a two-stage CoT-formatted training approach to progressively enhance its step-by-step reasoning abilities. Furthermore, we propose an effective inference-time scaling strategy that enables Corvid to mitigate over-reasoning and under-reasoning through self-verification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Corvid outperforms existing o1-like MLLMs and state-of-the-art MLLMs with similar parameter scales, with notable strengths in mathematical reasoning and science problem-solving. Project page: https://mm-vl.github.io/corvid.
papers.curator_note: 面向思维链推理改进多模态大模型
papers.title_zh: Corvid：改进多模态大语言模型以支持思维链推理
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的最新进展在模态感知与理解上表现出色。然而领先的开源 MLLM 在复杂结构化推理上仍有明显短板，尤其缺乏为决策与解决问题所需的深度推理。本工作提出 Corvid——一个具备增强思维链（CoT）推理能力的 MLLM。架构上，Corvid 采用混合视觉编码器以获得信息量充足的视觉表征，并设计了一个精巧的连接模块（GateMixer）促进跨模态对齐。为增强 Corvid 的 CoT 推理能力，我们构建了 MCoT-Instruct-287K——一个由多样公开推理数据源精炼、标准化而成的高质量多模态 CoT 指令跟随数据集。借助该数据集，我们用两阶段的 CoT 格式化训练对 Corvid 微调，循序渐进地强化其逐步推理能力。此外我们提出有效的推理时扩展策略，使 Corvid 能通过自我校验缓解「过度推理」与「推理不足」。大量实验表明，在相近参数规模下 Corvid 优于现有的类 o1 MLLM 与最先进 MLLM，并在数学推理与科学问题求解上表现突出。项目页：https://mm-vl.github.io/corvid。

papers.title: Enhancing Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models through Reasoning-based Segmentation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in point cloud perception have demonstrated remarkable progress in scene understanding through vision-language alignment leveraging large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods may still encounter challenges in handling complex instructions that require accurate spatial reasoning, even if the 3D point cloud data provides detailed spatial cues such as size and position for identifying the targets. To tackle this issue, we propose Relevant Reasoning Segmentation (R^2S), a reasoning-based segmentation framework. The framework emulates human cognitive processes by decomposing spatial reasoning into two sequential stages: first identifying relevant elements, then processing instructions guided by their associated visual priors. Furthermore, acknowledging the inadequacy of existing datasets in complex reasoning tasks, we introduce 3D ReasonSeg, a reasoning-based segmentation dataset comprising 25,185 training samples and 3,966 validation samples with precise annotations. Both quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that the R^2S and 3D ReasonSeg effectively endow 3D point cloud perception with stronger spatial reasoning capabilities, and we hope that they can serve as a new baseline and benchmark for future work.
papers.curator_note: 以推理式分割增强多模态大模型空间推理
papers.title_zh: 通过推理式分割增强多模态大模型的空间推理能力
papers.abstract_zh: 点云感知的最新进展表明，借助大语言模型（LLM）进行视觉—语言对齐已能在场景理解上取得可观成果。然而即便三维点云数据提供了尺寸、位置等用于识别目标的精细空间线索，现有方法在处理需要准确空间推理的复杂指令时仍会遇到困难。为解决该问题，我们提出相关推理分割框架 R²S——一个基于推理的分割框架。它模仿人类认知过程，把空间推理拆解为先后两个阶段：先识别相关要素，再在其关联视觉先验的引导下处理指令。此外，考虑到现有数据集在复杂推理任务上的不足，我们构建 3D ReasonSeg——一个基于推理的分割数据集，含 25,185 个训练样本与 3,966 个验证样本，标注精确。定量与定性实验均表明，R²S 与 3D ReasonSeg 能有效赋予三维点云感知更强的空间推理能力；我们希望它们能为后续工作提供新的基线与基准。

papers.title: Prompt-A-Video: Prompt Your Video Diffusion Model via Preference-Aligned LLM
papers.abstract: Text-to-video models have made remarkable advancements through optimization on high-quality text-video pairs, where the textual prompts play a pivotal role in determining quality of output videos. However, achieving the desired output often entails multiple revisions and iterative inference to refine user-provided prompts. Current automatic methods for refining prompts encounter challenges such as Modality-Inconsistency, Cost-Discrepancy, and Model-Unaware when applied to text-to-video diffusion models. To address these problem, we introduce an LLM-based prompt adaptation framework, termed as Prompt-A-Video, which excels in crafting Video-Centric, Labor-Free and Preference-Aligned prompts tailored to specific video diffusion model. Our approach involves a meticulously crafted two-stage optimization and alignment system. Initially, we conduct a reward-guided prompt evolution pipeline to automatically create optimal prompts pool and leverage them for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of the LLM. Then multi-dimensional rewards are employed to generate pairwise data for the SFT model, followed by the direct preference optimization (DPO) algorithm to further facilitate preference alignment. Through extensive experimentation and comparative analyses, we validate the effectiveness of Prompt-A-Video across diverse generation models, highlighting its potential to push the boundaries of video generation.
papers.curator_note: 偏好对齐 LLM 为视频扩散模型写提示
papers.title_zh: Prompt-A-Video：用偏好对齐的大语言模型为视频扩散模型写提示
papers.abstract_zh: 文本生成视频模型通过在高质量「文本—视频」配对数据上优化已取得长足进步，其中文本提示对输出视频质量起着关键作用。然而要得到满意的输出，往往需要多轮修改与迭代推理来打磨用户提供的提示。现有的提示自动改写方法应用于文生视频扩散模型时，面临模态不一致、成本不对等与模型不可知等难题。为此我们提出基于 LLM 的提示自适应框架 Prompt-A-Video，它擅长为特定的视频扩散模型量身打造「以视频为中心、免人工、偏好对齐」的提示。我们的方法包含一套精心设计的两阶段优化与对齐系统：首先执行奖励引导的提示演化流程，自动构建最优提示池并用其对 LLM 做监督微调（SFT）；随后用多维奖励为 SFT 模型生成成对比较数据，再以直接偏好优化（DPO）算法进一步完成偏好对齐。通过大量实验与对比分析，我们在多种生成模型上验证了 Prompt-A-Video 的有效性，展现其推进视频生成边界的潜力。

papers.title: Dense2MoE: Restructuring Diffusion Transformer to MoE for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) has demonstrated remarkable performance in text-to-image generation; however, its large parameter size results in substantial inference overhead. Existing parameter compression methods primarily focus on pruning, but aggressive pruning often leads to severe performance degradation due to reduced model capacity. To address this limitation, we pioneer the transformation of a dense DiT into a Mixture of Experts (MoE) for structured sparsification, reducing the number of activated parameters while preserving model capacity. Specifically, we replace the Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) in DiT Blocks with MoE layers, reducing the number of activated parameters in the FFNs by 62.5%.Furthermore, we propose the Mixture of Blocks (MoB) to selectively activate DiT blocks, thereby further enhancing sparsity.To ensure an effective dense-to-MoE conversion, we design a multi-step distillation pipeline, incorporating Taylor metric-based expert initialization, knowledge distillation with load balancing, and group feature loss for MoB optimization. We transform large diffusion transformers (e.g., FLUX.1 [dev]) into an MoE structure, reducing activated parameters by 60% while maintaining original performance and surpassing pruning-based approaches in extensive experiments. Overall, Dense2MoE establishes a new paradigm for efficient text-to-image generation.
papers.curator_note: 把扩散 Transformer 重构为 MoE 做高效文生图
papers.title_zh: Dense2MoE：把扩散 Transformer 重构为混合专家以实现高效文生图
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）在文生图任务上表现卓越，但其庞大的参数量带来可观的推理开销。现有参数压缩方法多以剪枝为主，而激进剪枝会因模型容量下降导致严重性能退化。为解决这一局限，我们率先把稠密 DiT 转换为混合专家（MoE）以实现结构化稀疏：在保留模型容量的同时减少被激活的参数数量。具体而言，我们把 DiT 模块中的前馈网络（FFN）替换为 MoE 层，使 FFN 中被激活的参数减少 62.5%；进而提出「模块混合」（MoB）以选择性激活 DiT 模块，进一步提升稀疏度。为保证稠密到 MoE 的有效转换，我们设计了多步蒸馏流程，包含基于泰勒度量的专家初始化、带负载均衡的知识蒸馏，以及用于 MoB 优化的分组特征损失。我们把大型扩散 Transformer（如 FLUX.1 [dev]）改造为 MoE 结构，在激活参数减少 60% 的同时保持原有性能，并在大量实验中超越基于剪枝的方法。总体上，Dense2MoE 为高效文生图确立了新范式。

papers.title: SEGS-SLAM: Structure-enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Appearance Embedding
papers.abstract: 3D Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has recently revolutionized novel view synthesis in the simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) problem. However, most existing algorithms fail to fully capture the underlying structure, resulting in structural inconsistency. Additionally, they struggle with abrupt appearance variations, leading to inconsistent visual quality. To address these problems, we propose SEGS-SLAM, a structure-enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM, which achieves high-quality photorealistic mapping. Our main contributions are two-fold. First, we propose a structure-enhanced photorealistic mapping (SEPM) framework that, for the first time, leverages highly structured point cloud to initialize structured 3D Gaussians, leading to significant improvements in rendering quality. Second, we propose Appearance-from-Motion embedding (AfME), enabling 3D Gaussians to better model image appearance variations across different camera poses. Extensive experiments on monocular, stereo, and RGB-D datasets demonstrate that SEGS-SLAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in photorealistic mapping quality, e.g., an improvement of 19.86% in PSNR over MonoGS on the TUM RGB-D dataset for monocular cameras. The project page is available at https://segs-slam.github.io/.
papers.curator_note: 结构增强的高斯泼溅 SLAM
papers.title_zh: SEGS-SLAM：外观嵌入驱动的结构增强三维高斯泼溅 SLAM
papers.abstract_zh: 三维高斯泼溅（3D-GS）近期在同步定位与建图（SLAM）的新视角合成任务上带来变革。然而多数现有算法无法充分刻画底层结构，导致结构不一致；此外它们难以应对突变的表观变化，造成视觉质量不稳定。为解决这些问题，我们提出 SEGS-SLAM——一个结构增强的三维高斯泼溅 SLAM，可实现高质量的照片级建图。我们的贡献有二：其一，提出结构增强照片级建图（SEPM）框架，首次利用高度结构化的点云初始化结构化三维高斯，显著提升渲染质量；其二，提出「由运动还原外观」嵌入（AfME），使三维高斯能更好地建模不同相机位姿下的图像外观变化。在单目、双目与 RGB-D 数据集上的大量实验表明，SEGS-SLAM 在照片级建图质量上显著优于最先进方法，例如在 TUM RGB-D 数据集单相机设定下 PSNR 较 MonoGS 提升 19.86%。项目页：https://segs-slam.github.io/。

papers.title: EmbodiedOcc: Embodied 3D Occupancy Prediction for Vision-based Online Scene Understanding
papers.abstract: 3D occupancy prediction provides a comprehensive description of the surrounding scenes and has become an essential task for 3D perception. Most existing methods focus on offline perception from one or a few views and cannot be applied to embodied agents that demand to gradually perceive the scene through progressive embodied exploration. In this paper, we formulate an embodied 3D occupancy prediction task to target this practical scenario and propose a Gaussian-based EmbodiedOcc framework to accomplish it. We initialize the global scene with uniform 3D semantic Gaussians and progressively update local regions observed by the embodied agent. For each update, we extract semantic and structural features from the observed image and efficiently incorporate them via deformable cross-attention to refine the regional Gaussians. Finally, we employ Gaussian-to-voxel splatting to obtain the global 3D occupancy from the updated 3D Gaussians. Our EmbodiedOcc assumes an unknown (i.e., uniformly distributed) environment and maintains an explicit global memory of it with 3D Gaussians. It gradually gains knowledge through the local refinement of regional Gaussians, which is consistent with how humans understand new scenes through embodied exploration. We reorganize an EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet benchmark based on local annotations to facilitate the evaluation of the embodied 3D occupancy prediction task. Our EmbodiedOcc outperforms existing methods by a large margin and accomplishes the embodied occupancy prediction with high accuracy and efficiency. Code: https://github.com/YkiWu/EmbodiedOcc.
papers.curator_note: 具身式 3D 占据预测做在线场景理解
papers.title_zh: EmbodiedOcc：面向视觉在线场景理解的具身三维占据预测
papers.abstract_zh: 三维占据预测能完整描述周边场景，已成为三维感知的核心任务之一。现有方法多聚焦于单视图或少量视图的离线感知，无法用于需要具身智能体通过渐进式探索逐步感知场景的实际情形。本文把这一实用场景形式化为「具身三维占据预测」任务，并提出基于高斯的 EmbodiedOcc 框架来完成它。我们用均匀的三维语义高斯初始化全局场景，并随具身智能体的观测渐进更新局部区域；每次更新时，从观测图像中提取语义与结构特征，通过可变形交叉注意力高效融合以细化区域高斯；最后用「高斯体素泼溅」从更新后的三维高斯得到全局三维占据。EmbodiedOcc 假设环境未知（即初始为均匀分布），并用三维高斯维护对其显式的全局记忆，通过区域高斯的局部细化逐步获得认知——这与人类通过具身探索理解新场景的方式一致。我们基于局部标注重构了 EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet 基准，以支撑具身三维占据预测任务的评测。EmbodiedOcc 大幅超越现有方法，以高精度与高效率完成了具身占据预测。代码：https://github.com/YkiWu/EmbodiedOcc。

papers.title: PathFinder: A Multi-Modal Multi-Agent System for Medical Diagnostic Decision-Making Applied to Histopathology
papers.abstract: Diagnosing diseases through histopathology whole slide images (WSIs) is fundamental in modern pathology but is challenged by the gigapixel scale and complexity of WSIs. Trained histopathologists overcome this challenge by navigating the WSI, looking for relevant patches, taking notes, and compiling them to produce a final holistic diagnostic. Traditional AI approaches, such as multiple instance learning and transformer-based models, fail short of such a holistic, iterative, multi-scale diagnostic procedure, limiting their adoption in the real-world. We introduce PathFinder, a multi-modal, multi-agent framework that emulates the decision-making process of expert pathologists. PathFinder integrates four AI agents, the Triage Agent, Navigation Agent, Description Agent, and Diagnosis Agent, that collaboratively navigate WSIs, gather evidence, and provide comprehensive diagnoses with natural language explanations. The Triage Agent classifies the WSI as benign or risky; if risky, the Navigation and Description Agents iteratively focus on significant regions, generating importance maps and descriptive insights of sampled patches. Finally, the Diagnosis Agent synthesizes the findings to determine the patient's diagnostic classification. Our Experiments show that PathFinder outperforms state-of-the-art methods in skin melanoma diagnosis by 8% while offering inherent explainability through natural language descriptions of diagnostically relevant patches. Qualitative analysis by pathologists shows that the Description Agent's outputs are of high quality and comparable to GPT-4o. PathFinder is also the first AI-based system to surpass the average performance of pathologists in this challenging melanoma classification task by 9%, setting a new record for efficient, accurate, and interpretable AI-assisted diagnostics in pathology. Our Data, code and models will be made available.
papers.curator_note: 组织病理诊断决策的多模态多智能体系统
papers.title_zh: PathFinder：应用于组织病理学的多模态多智能体辅助诊断决策系统
papers.abstract_zh: 通过组织病理全切片图像（WSI）诊断疾病是现代病理学的基石，但 WSI 的吉像素尺度与复杂性带来严峻挑战。受过训练病理医生的做法是：在全切片中导航、寻找相关图块、做笔记，并把它们汇总成最终的整体诊断。传统 AI 方法（如多示例学习与基于 Transformer 的模型）达不到这种整体性、迭代式、多尺度的诊断流程，限制了其在真实场景中的应用。我们提出 PathFinder——一个模仿专家病理医生决策过程的多模态、多智能体框架。PathFinder 整合四个 AI 智能体：分诊智能体、导航智能体、描述智能体与诊断智能体，它们协作在全切片中导航、收集证据，并给出带有自然语言解释的完整诊断。分诊智能体先把 WSI 判定为良性或高危；若为高危，导航与描述智能体迭代聚焦关键区域，生成重要性图谱并对采样图块给出描述性洞见；最后诊断智能体综合所获发现给出患者的诊断分类。实验表明，PathFinder 在皮肤黑色素瘤诊断上超越最先进方法 8%，并通过对诊断相关图块的自然语言描述天然具备可解释性。病理医生的定性分析显示，描述智能体的输出质量高、与 GPT-4o 相当。PathFinder 还是首个在这一高难黑色素瘤分类任务上平均表现超过病理医生的 AI 系统（高出 9%），为高效、准确、可解释的病理 AI 辅助诊断树立了新纪录。数据、代码与模型将公开发布。

papers.title: TrustMark: Robust Watermarking and Watermark Removal for Arbitrary Resolution Images
papers.abstract: Imperceptible digital watermarking is important in copyright protection, misinformation prevention, and responsible generative AI. We propose TrustMark - a watermarking method that leverages a spatio-spectral loss function and a 1x1 convolution layer to enhance encoding quality. TrustMark is robust against both in-place and out-of-place perturbations while maintaining image quality above 43 dB. Additionally, we propose ReMark, a watermark removal method designed for re-watermarking, along with a simple yet effective algorithm that enables both TrustMark and ReMark to operate across arbitrary resolutions. Our methods achieve state-of-art performance on 3 benchmarks.
papers.curator_note: 任意分辨率图像的鲁棒水印与水印去除
papers.title_zh: TrustMark：适用于任意分辨率图像的鲁棒水印与水印去除
papers.abstract_zh: 不可感知的数字水印对版权保护、虚假信息防范与负责任的生成式 AI 都至关重要。我们提出 TrustMark——一种利用「空域—频域」联合损失函数与 1×1 卷积层来提升编码质量的水印方法。TrustMark 对原位扰动与离位扰动都保持鲁棒，同时图像质量维持在 43 dB 以上。此外我们提出 ReMark——一个为「重新加水印」设计的水印去除方法，并给出一套简洁而有效的算法，使 TrustMark 与 ReMark 都能在任意分辨率上运行。我们的方法在 3 个基准上取得当前最优表现。

papers.title: Feature Purification Matters: Suppressing Outlier Propagation for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation has advanced with vision-language models like CLIP, which exhibit strong zero-shot abilities. However, CLIP's attention mechanism often wrongly emphasises specific image tokens, namely outliers, which results in irrelevant over-activation. Existing approaches struggle with these outliers that arise in intermediate layers and propagate through the model, ultimately degrading spatial perception. In this paper, we propose a Self-adaptive Feature Purifier framework (SFP) to suppress propagated outliers and enhance semantic representations for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. Specifically, based on an in-depth analysis of attention responses between image and class tokens, we design a self-adaptive outlier mitigator to detect and mitigate outliers at each layer for propagated feature purification. In addition, we introduce a semantic-aware attention enhancer to augment attention intensity in semantically relevant regions, which strengthens the purified feature to focus on objects. Further, we introduce a hierarchical attention integrator to aggregate multi-layer attention maps to refine spatially coherent feature representations for final segmentation. Our proposed SFP enables robust outlier suppression and object-centric feature representation, leading to a more precise segmentation. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance and surpasses existing methods by an average of 4.6% mIoU on eight segmentation benchmarks. The code will be released.
papers.curator_note: 抑制离群传播的免训练开放词表语义分割
papers.title_zh: 特征提纯至关重要：抑制离群值传播的免训练开放词表语义分割
papers.abstract_zh: 以 CLIP 这类视觉语言模型为代表的免训练开放词表语义分割已取得进展，它们展现出强大的零样本能力。然而 CLIP 的注意力机制常常错误地强调某些图像 token（即离群值），造成无关的过度激活。现有方法难以处理这些在中间层产生、并在网络中不断传播的离群值，最终损害空间感知能力。本文提出自适应特征提纯框架 SFP，用于抑制被传播的离群值并增强面向开放词表语义分割的语义表征。具体而言，在深入分析图像 token 与类别 token 之间注意力响应的基础上，我们设计自适应离群值抑制器，在每一层检测并削弱离群值，实现传播特征的逐层提纯；同时引入语义感知注意力增强器，提升语义相关区域的注意力强度，使提纯后的特征更聚焦于目标；进一步提出分层注意力整合器，聚合多层注意力图以细化空间连贯的特征表征，服务最终分割。SFP 能稳健抑制离群值并形成以目标为中心的特征表征，从而获得更精确的分割。大量实验显示本方法达到当前最优水平，在八个分割基准上平均 mIoU 超越现有方法 4.6%。代码将开源。

papers.title: EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic Vision Transformer
papers.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have emerged as a foundational model in computer vision, excelling in generalization and adaptation to downstream tasks. However, deploying ViTs to support diverse resource constraints typically requires retraining multiple, size-specific ViTs, which is both time-consuming and energy-intensive. To address this issue, we propose an efficient ViT adaptation framework that enables a single adaptation process to generate multiple models of varying sizes for deployment on platforms with various resource constraints. Our approach comprises two stages. In the first stage, we enhance a pre-trained ViT with a nested elastic architecture that enables structural flexibility across MLP expansion ratio, number of attention heads, embedding dimension, and network depth. To preserve pre-trained knowledge and ensure stable adaptation, we adopt a curriculum-based training strategy that progressively increases elasticity. In the second stage, we design a lightweight router to select submodels according to computational budgets and downstream task demands. Initialized with Pareto-optimal configurations derived via a customized NSGA-II algorithm, the router is then jointly optimized with the backbone. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of EA-ViT. The code is available at https://github.com/zcxcf/EA-ViT.
papers.curator_note: 弹性视觉 Transformer 的高效适配
papers.title_zh: EA-ViT：弹性视觉 Transformer 的高效适配
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉 Transformer（ViT）已成为计算机视觉的基础模型，在下游任务的泛化与适配上表现出色。然而要让 ViT 服务多样的资源约束，通常不得不针对每种尺寸分别重训多个模型，既耗时又耗能。为解决该问题，我们提出一个高效的 ViT 适配框架：只需一次适配过程，即可生成多种尺寸的模型，部署到不同资源约束的平台上。方法分两阶段。第一阶段，我们为预训练 ViT 叠加嵌套式弹性架构，使其在 MLP 扩张比、注意力头数、嵌入维度与网络深度四个维度上具备结构柔性；为保留预训练知识并保证适配稳定，采用课程式训练策略逐步提升弹性程度。第二阶段，我们设计一个轻量路由器，按算力预算与下游任务需求选择子模型；路由器以定制 NSGA-II 算法求得的帕累托最优配置初始化，随后与主干网络联合优化。在多个基准上的大量实验证明了 EA-ViT 的有效性与通用性。代码见 https://github.com/zcxcf/EA-ViT。

papers.title: VecInfer: Efficient LLM Inference with Low-Bit KV Cache via Outlier-Suppressed Vector Quantization
papers.abstract: The Key-Value (KV) cache introduces substantial memory overhead during large language model (LLM) inference. Although existing vector quantization (VQ) methods reduce KV cache usage and provide flexible representational capacity across bit-widths, they suffer severe performance degradation at ultra-low bit-widths due to key cache outliers that hinder effective codebook utilization. To address this challenge, we propose VecInfer, a novel VQ method for aggressive KV cache compression while enabling efficient inference. By applying smooth and Hadamard transformations, VecInfer suppresses outliers in the key cache, enabling the codebook to comprehensively cover the original data distribution and thereby reducing quantization difficulty. To facilitate efficient deployment, we design an optimized CUDA kernel that fuses computation with dequantization to minimize memory access overhead. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VecInfer consistently outperforms existing quantization baselines across both long-context understanding and mathematical reasoning tasks. With only 2-bit quantization, VecInfer achieves performance comparable to full precision, while delivering up to 2.7× speedup in large-batch self-attention computation and 8.3× reduction in single-batch end-to-end latency on Llama-3.1-8B with a 196k sequence length.
papers.curator_note: 离群点抑制向量量化做低比特 KV Cache 高效推理
papers.title_zh: VecInfer：以离群值抑制向量量化实现低比特 KV 缓存的高效大模型推理
papers.abstract_zh: 键值（KV）缓存在大语言模型（LLM）推理过程中带来可观的显存开销。尽管已有的向量量化（VQ）方法能降低 KV 缓存占用，并在不同位宽之间提供灵活的表征能力，但由于 Key 缓存中的离群值会妨碍码本的有效利用，这些方法在极低比特位宽下会出现严重的性能退化。为应对该挑战，我们提出 VecInfer——一种在实现激进 KV 缓存压缩的同时保持高效推理的新型 VQ 方法。通过施加平滑变换与 Hadamard 变换，VecInfer 抑制 Key 缓存中的离群值，使码本得以完整覆盖原始数据分布，从而降低量化难度。为便于高效部署，我们设计了优化的 CUDA 核函数，把计算与反量化融合，以最小化访存开销。大量评测表明，在长上下文理解与数学推理两类任务上，VecInfer 一致优于现存的量化基线。仅需 2 比特量化，VecInfer 即可取得与全精度相当的表现，同时在大批量自注意力计算中带来最高 2.7× 的加速，并在 Llama-3.1-8B、196k 序列长度下单批端到端延迟降低 8.3×。

papers.title: MobileLLM-Flash: Latency-Guided On-Device LLM Design for Industry Scale Deployment
papers.abstract: Real-time AI experiences call for on-device large language models (OD-LLMs) optimized for efficient deployment on resource-constrained hardware. The most useful OD-LLMs produce near-real-time responses and exhibit broad hardware compatibility, maximizing user reach. We present a methodology for designing such models using hardware-in-the-loop architecture search under mobile latency constraints. This system is amenable to industry-scale deployment: it generates models deployable without custom kernels and compatible with standard mobile runtimes like Executorch. Our methodology avoids specialized attention mechanisms and instead uses attention skipping for long-context acceleration. Our approach jointly optimizes model architecture (layers, dimensions) and attention pattern. To efficiently evaluate candidates, we treat each as a pruned version of a pretrained backbone with inherited weights, thereby achieving high accuracy with minimal continued pretraining. We leverage the low cost of latency evaluation in a staged process: learning an accurate latency model first, then searching for the Pareto-frontier across latency and quality.This yields MobileLLM-Flash, a family of foundation models (350M, 650M, 1.4B) for efficient on-device use with strong capabilities, supporting up to 8k context length. MobileLLM-Flash delivers up to 1.8x and 1.6x faster prefill and decode on mobile CPUs with comparable or superior quality. Our analysis of Pareto-frontier design choices offers actionable principles for OD-LLM design.
papers.curator_note: 延迟引导的端侧大模型设计，工业级部署
papers.title_zh: MobileLLM-Flash：面向工业级部署的延迟引导端侧大模型设计
papers.abstract_zh: 实时 AI 体验需要在资源受限硬件上高效部署的端侧大语言模型（OD-LLM）。最有用的端侧模型应当产出接近实时的响应，并具备广泛的硬件兼容性以覆盖最多用户。我们提出一套在移动端延迟约束下、借助「硬件在环」架构搜索来设计此类模型的方法论。该体系适合工业级部署：产出的模型无需定制核函数即可部署，并兼容 Executorch 等标准移动推理运行时。我们的方法论回避专用注意力机制，转而在长上下文加速中使用注意力跳跃。方法联合优化模型架构（层数、维度）与注意力模式。为高效评估候选模型，我们把每个候选视为预训练主干的一个剪枝版本并继承其权重，从而只需极少的继续预训练即可达到高精度。我们利用延迟评估成本低这一特点设计分阶段流程：先学习一个精确的延迟模型，再在延迟—质量两个维度上搜索帕累托前沿。最终得到 MobileLLM-Flash 系列基座模型（350M、650M、1.4B），在具备强劲能力的同时支持端侧高效使用，最长支持 8k 上下文。在质量相当或更优的前提下，MobileLLM-Flash 在移动 CPU 上的 prefill 与 decode 速度分别最高提升 1.8 倍与 1.6 倍。我们对帕累托前沿设计选择的分析，为端侧大模型设计提供了可操作的原则。

papers.title: The Reasoning Trap: How Enhancing LLM Reasoning Amplifies Tool Hallucination
papers.abstract: Enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a key strategy for building agents that ”think then act”. However, recent observations, like OpenAI’s o3, suggest a paradox: stronger reasoning often coincides with increased hallucination, yet no prior work has systematically examined whether reasoning enhancement itself causes tool hallucination. We address this gap with the central question: Does strengthening reasoning increase tool hallucination? To answer this, we introduce SimpleToolHalluBench, a diagnostic benchmark measuring tool hallucination in two failure modes: (i) no tool available, and (ii) only distractor tools available. Through controlled experiments, we establish three key findings. First, we demonstrate a causal relationship: progressively enhancing reasoning through RL increases tool hallucination proportionally with task performance gains. Second, this effect transcends overfitting—training on non-tool tasks (e.g., mathematics) still amplifies subsequent tool hallucination. Third, the effect is method-agnostic, appearing when reasoning is instilled via supervised fine-tuning and when it is merely elicited at inference by switching from direct answers to step-by-step thinking. We also evaluate mitigation strategies including Prompt Engineering and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), revealing a fundamental reliability–capability trade-off: reducing hallucination consistently degrades utility. Mechanistically, Reasoning RL disproportionately collapses tool-reliability–related representations, and hallucinations surface as amplified divergences concentrated in late-layer residual streams. These findings reveal that current reasoning enhancement methods inherently amplify tool hallucination, highlighting the need for new training objectives that jointly optimize for capability and reliability. Our implementation is provided at https://github.com/albert-y1n/Reasoning_Trap .
papers.curator_note: 揭示增强推理反而放大工具幻觉的推理陷阱
papers.title_zh: 推理陷阱：增强大模型推理能力如何放大工具幻觉
papers.abstract_zh: 增强大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，是构建「先思考后行动」智能体的关键策略。但近期的观察（如 OpenAI 的 o3）揭示了一个悖论：更强的推理往往伴随更多的幻觉，然而此前没有工作系统考察过「推理增强本身是否会导致工具幻觉」。我们以核心问题填补这一空白：强化推理是否会增加工具幻觉？为此我们提出 SimpleToolHalluBench，一个诊断性基准，从两种失效模式度量工具幻觉：（i）根本没有可用工具；（ii）只有干扰项工具可用。通过受控实验我们得到三点关键结论。第一，我们证实了因果关系：用强化学习逐步增强推理，工具幻觉会随任务性能的提升而同比例增加。第二，该效应并非过拟合——即使在非工具任务（如数学）上训练，仍会放大后续的工具幻觉。第三，该效应与方法无关：无论用监督微调注入推理能力，还是仅在推理时通过从直接作答切换为逐步思考来激发推理，效应都会出现。我们还评测了提示工程与直接偏好优化（DPO）等缓解策略，发现存在根本性的「可靠性—能力」权衡：降低幻觉总是以牺牲实用性为代价。从机制上看，推理强化学习会不成比例地压垮与工具可靠性相关的表征，而幻觉表现为集中在后段层残差流中被放大的分歧。这些发现表明：当前的推理增强方法会内生地放大工具幻觉，因此需要能同时优化能力与可靠性的新训练目标。实现见 https://github.com/albert-y1n/Reasoning_Trap。

papers.title: Why LLM Safety Guardrails Collapse After Fine-tuning: A Similarity Analysis Between Alignment and Fine-tuning Datasets
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have underscored their vulnerability to safety alignment jailbreaks, particularly when subjected to downstream fine-tuning. However, existing mitigation strategies primarily focus on reactively addressing jailbreak incidents after safety guardrails have been compromised, removing harmful gradients during fine-tuning, or continuously reinforcing safety alignment throughout fine-tuning. As such, they tend to overlook a critical upstream factor: the role of the original safety-alignment data. This paper therefore investigates the degradation of safety guardrails through the lens of representation similarity between upstream alignment datasets and downstream fine-tuning tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that high similarity between these datasets significantly weakens safety guardrails, making models more susceptible to jailbreaks. Conversely, low similarity between these two types of datasets yields substantially more robust models and thus reduces harmfulness score by up to 10.33%. By highlighting the importance of upstream dataset design in the building of durable safety guardrails and reducing real-world vulnerability to jailbreak attacks, these findings offer actionable insights for fine-tuning service providers to prioritize upstream models with low jailbreak risk.
papers.curator_note: 解释微调后安全护栏崩塌的对齐/微调数据相似度机理
papers.title_zh: 微调后大模型安全护栏为何崩塌：对齐数据与微调数据的相似度分析
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展凸显了其在安全对齐层面的脆弱性——越狱攻击频发，尤其在经历下游微调之后。然而现有缓解策略主要是在安全护栏已被突破之后被动应对越狱事件、在微调过程中移除有害梯度，或在整个微调期间持续强化安全对齐。这些做法往往忽视了一个关键的上游因素：原始安全对齐数据所扮演的角色。因此本文从「上游对齐数据集与下游微调任务之间的表征相似度」这一视角审视安全护栏的退化。实验表明，两类数据集之间的高相似度会显著削弱安全护栏，使模型更易被越狱；相反，二者相似度较低时得到的模型稳健性明显更强，有害性得分最多降低 10.33%。这些发现凸显了上游数据集设计对于构建持久安全护栏、降低真实世界越狱脆弱性的重要意义，也为微调服务提供方提供了可操作的建议：优先选择越狱风险低的上游模型。

papers.title: SEMA-RAG: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely employed to mitigate risks such as hallucinations and knowledge obsolescence in medical question answering, yet its predominantly single-round, static retrieval paradigm misaligns with the multi-stage process of clinical reasoning. This compressed workflow induces two structural deficiencies: question-to-query translation often lacks clinically grounded semantic interpretation, and retrieval lacks iterative sufficiency feedback, making it difficult to form reliable evidence chains. We argue that both issues stem from a deeper cause—overloading a single reasoning chain with heterogeneous tasks of interpretation, exploration, and adjudication—and that the remedy is to reconstruct the workflow via task decoupling and dynamic multi-round exploration. To this end, we propose the Self-Evolving Multi-Agent framework SEMA-RAG , which assigns these roles to three specialist agents: Interpreter Agent for clinical schema interpretation, Explorer Agent for sufficiency-driven self-evolving retrieval, and Arbiter Agent for evidence adjudication and answer selection. Across five benchmarks and five LLM backbones, SEMA-RAG improves the strongest baseline by +6.46 accuracy points on average, measured per backbone.
papers.curator_note: 自演化多智能体检索增强生成框架用于医学推理
papers.title_zh: SEMA-RAG：面向医学推理的自演化多智能体检索增强生成框架
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）被广泛用于缓解医学问答中的幻觉与知识过时等风险，但其以单轮、静态检索为主的范式与临床推理的多阶段过程并不匹配。这种被压缩的工作流程带来两个结构性缺陷：从问题到查询的转换往往缺乏有临床依据的语义解释；检索也没有充分的迭代反馈，难以形成可靠的证据链。我们认为这两个问题源于同一深层原因——把解释、探索、裁断这三类异质任务压在同一条推理链上；解决之道在于通过任务解耦与动态多轮探索重建工作流程。为此我们提出自演化多智能体框架 SEMA-RAG，把这三类角色分配给三个专职智能体：解释智能体负责临床方案解读，探索智能体负责以「充分性」驱动的自演化检索，裁断智能体负责证据裁定与答案选择。在五个基准与五种 LLM 主干上，SEMA-RAG 相对最强基线平均提升 6.46 个准确率百分点（按各主干分别度量）。

papers.title: “I See What You Did There”: Can Large Vision-Language Models Understand Multimodal Puns?
papers.abstract: Puns are a common form of rhetorical wordplay that exploits polysemy and phonetic similarity to create humor. In multimodal puns, visual and textual elements synergize to ground the literal sense and evoke the figurative meaning simultaneously. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely used in multimodal understanding and generation, their ability to understand puns has not been systematically studied due to a scarcity of rigorous benchmarks. To address this, we first propose a multimodal pun generation pipeline. We then introduce MultiPun, a dataset comprising diverse types of puns alongside adversarial non-pun distractors. Our evaluation reveals that most models struggle to distinguish genuine puns from these distractors. Moreover, we propose both prompt-level and model-level strategies to enhance pun comprehension, with an average improvement of 16.5% in F1 scores. Our findings provide valuable insights for developing future VLMs that master the subtleties of human-like humor via cross-modal reasoning.
papers.curator_note: 考察大型视觉语言模型能否理解多模态双关
papers.title_zh: 「我看出你的巧思了」：大型视觉语言模型能理解多模态双关吗？
papers.abstract_zh: 双关是一种常见的修辞性文字游戏，利用一词多义与语音相似制造幽默。在多模态双关中，视觉与文本元素协同作用，同时接地字面义并唤起引申义。尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）已广泛用于多模态理解与生成，但由于缺乏严谨基准，其理解双关的能力尚未被系统研究。为此，我们首先提出一条多模态双关生成流水线；随后发布 MultiPun 数据集，包含多样的双关类型以及对抗性的「非双关」干扰样本。评测显示，多数模型难以把真正的双关与这些干扰项区分开。此外我们提出提示层面与模型层面两类策略来增强双关理解，F1 分数平均提升 16.5%。我们的发现为未来研发能凭跨模态推理掌握类人幽默微妙之处的 VLM 提供了有价值的洞见。

papers.title: LADR: Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation with Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Discrete Diffusion Language Models have emerged as a compelling paradigm for unified multimodal generation, yet their deployment is hindered by high inference latency arising from iterative decoding. Existing acceleration strategies often require expensive re-training or fail to leverage the 2D spatial redundancy inherent in visual data. To address this, we propose Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue (LADR), a training-free method that expedites inference by exploiting the spatial Markov property of images. LADR prioritizes the recovery of tokens at the “generation frontier”, regions spatially adjacent to observed pixels, thereby maximizing information gain. Specifically, our method integrates morphological neighbor identification to locate candidate tokens, employs a risk-bounded filtering mechanism to prevent error propagation, and utilizes manifold-consistent inverse scheduling to align the diffusion trajectory with the accelerated mask density. Extensive experiments on four text-to-image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our LADR achieves an approximate 4 × speedup over standard baselines. Remarkably, it maintains or even enhances generative fidelity, particularly in spatial reasoning tasks, offering a state-of-the-art trade-off between efficiency and quality.
papers.curator_note: 扩散大模型文生图的局部感知动态救援加速
papers.title_zh: LADR：面向扩散大语言模型高效文生图的局部感知动态救援
papers.abstract_zh: 离散扩散语言模型已成为统一多模态生成的一种颇具吸引力的范式，但其迭代解码带来的高推理延迟阻碍了部署。现有加速策略要么需要代价高昂的重新训练，要么未能利用视觉数据固有的二维空间冗余。为此我们提出局部感知动态救援（LADR），一种免训练方法，通过利用图像的「空间马尔可夫性质」加速推理。LADR 优先恢复位于「生成前沿」的 token——即与已观测像素在空间上相邻的区域，从而最大化信息增益。具体而言，本方法整合形态学邻域识别以定位候选 token，采用风险有界的筛选机制以阻止误差传播，并使用流形一致的逆序调度使扩散轨迹与加速后的掩码密度相对齐。在四个文生图基准上的大量实验表明，LADR 相比标准基线取得约 4× 的加速；值得注意的是，它保持甚至提升了生成保真度，在空间推理任务上尤其如此，在效率与质量之间给出了当前最优的折衷。

papers.title: Biomedical Question Answering via Multi-Level Summarization on a Local Knowledge Graph
papers.abstract: In Question Answering (QA), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) has revolutionized performance in various domains. However, how to effectively capture multi-document relationships remains an open question. This is particularly critical for biomedical tasks due to their reliance on information spread across multiple documents. In this work, we propose a novel method CLAIMS, which utilizes propositional claims to construct a local knowledge graph from retrieved documents. Summaries are then derived via layerwise summarization from the knowledge graph to contextualize a small language model to perform QA. The structured summaries effectively capture explicit and implicit relationships between entities in the documents, thus having a more comprehensive context to provide to LLMs. CLAIMS achieved comparable or superior performance over RAG baselines on several biomedical QA benchmarks. We also evaluated its generalizability and each individual step of our approach with a targeted set of metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness.
papers.curator_note: 本地知识图谱多级摘要驱动的生物医药问答
papers.title_zh: 基于局部知识图谱多层摘要的生物医药问答
papers.abstract_zh: 在问答（QA）领域，检索增强生成（RAG）已革命性地提升了多个领域的表现。但如何有效捕捉多文档之间的关系仍是悬而未决的问题；由于生物医药任务依赖散落在多篇文档中的信息，这一点尤为关键。本文提出新方法 CLAIMS：利用命题式陈述（claim）从检索到的文档构建局部知识图谱，再从知识图谱出发逐层摘要，为小语言模型提供上下文以完成问答。这类结构化摘要能有效捕捉文档中实体之间的显式与隐式关系，因此可以为大语言模型提供更完整的上下文。CLAIMS 在多个生物医药问答基准上取得与 RAG 基线相当或更优的表现。我们还用一组有针对性的指标评估了它的泛化能力以及方法中每一个步骤，验证了其有效性。

papers.title: From Nodes to Narratives: Explaining Graph Neural Networks with LLMs and Graph Context
papers.abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful tools for learning over structured data, including text-attributed graphs (TAGs), which are common in domains such as citation networks, social platforms, and knowledge graphs. GNNs are not inherently interpretable and thus, many explanation methods have been proposed. However, existing explanation methods often struggle to generate interpretable, fine-grained rationales, especially when node attributes include rich natural language. In this work, we introduce GSPELL, a lightweight, post-hoc framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to generate faithful and interpretable explanations for GNN predictions. GSPELL projects GNN node embeddings into the LLM embedding space and constructs hybrid prompts that interleave soft prompts with textual inputs from the graph structure. This enables the LLM to reason about GNN internal representations and to produce natural-language explanations, along with concise explanation subgraphs. Our experiments across real-world TAG datasets demonstrate that GSPELL achieves a favorable trade-off between fidelity and sparsity, while improving human-centric metrics such as insightfulness. GSPELL sets a new direction for LLM-based explainability in graph learning by aligning GNN internals with human reasoning.
papers.curator_note: 用 LLM 与图上下文解释图神经网络节点到叙事
papers.title_zh: 从节点到叙事：用大语言模型与图上下文解释图神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 图神经网络（GNN）已成为在结构化数据上学习的有力工具，其中包括引文网络、社交平台与知识图谱等领域常见的文本属性图（TAG）。GNN 本身并不具备可解释性，因此学界提出了许多解释方法。然而现有解释方法往往难以生成可理解、细粒度的判定依据，当节点属性包含丰富自然语言时尤其如此。本文提出 GSPELL——一个轻量的事后（post-hoc）框架，用大语言模型（LLM）为 GNN 的预测生成忠实且可理解的解释。GSPELL 把 GNN 的节点嵌入投影到 LLM 的嵌入空间，并构造把软提示与来自图结构的文本输入交替编排的混合提示。这使得 LLM 能够针对 GNN 的内部表征进行推理，产出自然语言解释，同时给出简明的解释子图。在真实世界 TAG 数据集上的实验表明，GSPELL 在忠实度与稀疏性之间取得良好折衷，并提升了「启发性」等以人为中心的指标。通过把 GNN 内部机理与人类推理方式对齐，GSPELL 为图学习中基于 LLM 的可解释性开辟了新方向。

papers.title: An Exploration of Mamba for Speech Self-Supervised Models
papers.abstract: While Mamba has demonstrated strong performance in language modeling, its potential as a speech self-supervised learning (SSL) model remains underexplored, with prior studies limited to isolated tasks. To address this, we explore Mamba-based HuBERT models as alternatives to Transformer-based SSL architectures. Leveraging the linear-time Selective State Space, these models enable fine-tuning on long-context ASR with significantly lower compute. Moreover, they show superior performance when fine-tuned for streaming ASR. Beyond fine-tuning, these models show competitive performance on SUPERB probing benchmarks, particularly in causal settings. Our analysis shows that they yield higher-quality quantized representations and capture speaker-related features more distinctly than Transformer-based models. These findings highlight Mamba-based SSL as a promising and complementary direction for long-sequence modeling, real-time speech modeling, and speech unit extraction. The codebase is available at https://github.com/hckuo145/Mamba-based-HuBERT .
papers.curator_note: 探索 Mamba 在语音自监督模型中的表现
papers.title_zh: Mamba 用于语音自监督模型的探索
papers.abstract_zh: Mamba 已在语言建模上展现出强劲表现，但它作为语音自监督学习（SSL）模型的潜力仍未被充分探索，已有研究局限于孤立任务。为解决这一空白，我们探索基于 Mamba 的 HuBERT 模型，作为基于 Transformer 的 SSL 架构的替代方案。得益于线性时间的选择性状态空间，这些模型能以显著更低的算力在长上下文语音识别（ASR）上做微调；在面向流式 ASR 微调时，它们也表现出更优的性能。除微调之外，这些模型在 SUPERB 探测基准上同样具备竞争力，在因果设定下尤为突出。我们的分析显示，相比基于 Transformer 的模型，它们能产出质量更高的量化表征，并更清晰地区分出与说话人相关的特征。这些发现说明，基于 Mamba 的 SSL 是长序列建模、实时语音建模与语音单元抽取方向上一个有前景且可互补的选择。代码库见 https://github.com/hckuo145/Mamba-based-HuBERT。

papers.title: DPWriter: Reinforcement Learning with Diverse Planning Branching for Creative Writing
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based enhancement of large language models (LLMs) often leads to reduced output diversity, undermining their utility in open-ended tasks like creative writing. Current methods lack explicit mechanisms for guiding diverse exploration and instead prioritize optimization efficiency and performance over diversity. This paper proposes an RL framework structured around a semi-structured long Chain-of-Thought (CoT), in which the generation process is decomposed into explicitly planned intermediate steps. We introduce a Diverse Planning Branching method that strategically introduces divergence at the planning phase based on diversity variation, alongside a group-aware diversity reward to encourage distinct trajectories. Experimental results on creative writing benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly improves output diversity without compromising generation quality, consistently outperforming existing baselines.
papers.curator_note: 多样化规划分支的强化学习做创意写作
papers.title_zh: DPWriter：以多样化规划分支做强化学习的创意写作
papers.abstract_zh: 基于强化学习（RL）增强大语言模型（LLM）往往导致输出多样性下降，从而削弱其在创意写作等开放式任务上的效用。现有方法缺乏引导多样化探索的显式机制，而是把优化效率与性能置于多样性之上。本文提出一个围绕「半结构化长思维链（CoT）」组织的 RL 框架：把生成过程分解为显式规划的中间步骤。我们引入多样化规划分支方法，依据多样性变化在规划阶段策略性地引入分歧，并配合组感知多样性奖励以鼓励彼此不同的轨迹。在创意写作基准上的实验表明，本方法在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著提升输出多样性，稳定优于现有基线。

papers.title: SceneLM: 3D-Aware Language Models for Editable 3D Scene Synthesis
papers.abstract: Synthesizing an editable 3D scene from a single RGB image is central to content creation, embodied-agent data generation, and AR/VR, yet remains challenging to achieve both high-fidelity reconstruction and convenient interactive editing. Existing geometry-based pipelines produce high-quality 3D results but are typically hard to refine without rerunning the full process, while LLM-driven procedural systems enable interactive tool use but are mostly text-driven and lack precise metric 3D understanding from images. We present SceneLM, a language-model-based framework that grounds 3D scene synthesis in visual evidence by recovering an executable metric 3D layout directly from a single image. Given an RGB image (and camera intrinsics when available), SceneLM outputs a JSON-form layout specifying each object’s category, 3D center, size, and discretized yaw, and then deterministically executes this layout with a tool suite to instantiate, place, and edit objects for iterative refinement. To train metric layout recovery at scale, we curate five datasets covering diverse indoor, outdoor, and tabletop scenes and convert heterogeneous 3D annotations into a unified instruction-tuning format. To improve numerical stability and metric accuracy while preserving the text interface, we augment autoregressive JSON generation with a lightweight geometry prediction branch and dual supervision. Experiments show that SceneLM substantially improves single-image 3D layout estimation over strong open and proprietary MLLM baselines, and yields higher-quality end-to-end scene generation in geometric consistency, physical plausibility, semantic alignment, and realism.
papers.curator_note: 3D 感知的语言模型做可编辑 3D 场景合成
papers.title_zh: SceneLM：面向可编辑三维场景合成的三维感知语言模型
papers.abstract_zh: 从单张 RGB 图像合成可编辑的三维场景，是内容创作、具身智能体数据生成与 AR/VR 的核心环节，但同时做到高保真重建与便捷的交互式编辑仍然很难。现有的几何流水线能产出高质量的三维结果，但若不重跑整个流程往往难以细化；而由 LLM 驱动的程序化系统虽支持交互式工具调用，却大多以文本驱动，缺乏从图像获得的精确度量三维理解。我们提出 SceneLM——一个基于语言模型的框架，通过直接从单张图像恢复「可执行的度量三维布局」，把三维场景合成锚定在视觉证据之上。给定一张 RGB 图像（以及可用时的相机内参），SceneLM 输出 JSON 格式的布局，指明每个物体的类别、三维中心、尺寸与离散化偏航角，随后用一套工具以确定性方式执行该布局，实例化、摆放并编辑物体以迭代打磨。为了大规模训练度量布局恢复，我们整理了覆盖室内外与桌面等多样场景的五个数据集，并把异构的三维标注统一转换为指令微调格式。为在保留文本接口的前提下提升数值稳定性与度量精度，我们为自回归 JSON 生成增设一个轻量几何预测分支并施加双重监督。实验表明，SceneLM 在单图三维布局估计上显著优于强大的开源与专有 MLLM 基线，并在几何一致性、物理合理性、语义对齐与真实感方面带来更高质量的端到端场景生成。
